event_semantics.armed: Tracer enabled and Texture entry reached, not eligible/admitted. Cap1.
event_semantics.admitted: Exact pending producer and independent slot admission passed. Not unique resource.
event_semantics.encode_permit_check: Borrower readability passed and duplicate upload/mips branch skipped. Not consumer draw/GPU execution.
event_semantics.producer_retired_check: Producer completed check passed in final prior-read callback. NOT consumer GPU completion.

limitations: Logged event occurrences are not unique resources or total event rates; same pair can repeat, independent caps and swallowed log exceptions apply.
Observed nonarmed events precede counted battle window; no performance/timing-gain claim from trace.
Producer retirement check does not prove consumer GPU completion.
Ordinary validation does not cover every failed submission/quarantine/context/revision/lifetime path.
next: Return to JINI. Actual CPU admission/checks observed before counted battle window; no FPS or unique-resource/consumer-GPU-completion claim. One-run scope closed; no automatic repeat/workload change.
